subject: gsd-2
tagline: Autonomous software factory: spec → milestone → isolated workers → verification, with an Agent Skills runtime.

capabilities.name: Agent Skills runtime
capabilities.description: Scans SKILL.md, injects XML catalog only, Skill tool loads bodies. auto/suggest/off discovery.

capabilities.name: Milestone artifact DAG
capabilities.description: .gsd/ PROJECT/REQUIREMENTS/DECISIONS/STATE + M###/S##/T## plan and summary files.

capabilities.name: Isolated typed subagents
capabilities.description: scout/planner/worker/reviewer with fresh context default; children cannot recurse.

capabilities.name: Headless orchestrator skill
capabilities.description: OpenClaw-facing skill drives gsd as subprocess with exit codes 0/1/10/11.

capabilities.name: Extension SDK + MCP
capabilities.description: Workflow plugins via .gsd/extensions plus first-party MCP server.

capabilities.name: File-path handoff
capabilities.description: continue.md written for a stranger: last/next/why/open/do-not.

unique_selling_points: Implements Agent Skills as a runtime, not just a pack
On-disk milestone state is the source of truth
Scout compresses context for agents who have not seen the files

limitations.description: README now redirects to open-gsd/gsd-pi; this clone is an archived snapshot (last commit 2026-05-22)
